swap.title: Swap equipment
swap.noteEquipment: Parent, location and Status follow the new position. Level follows the new parent; child equipment follow their parent.
swap.note: Parent, location and Status follow the new position.

eq.checkOutDesc: Put equipment from Not in use into In use. Its children and grandchildren follow.
eq.checkInDesc: Return equipment from In use to Not in use. Its children and grandchildren follow.
eq.detachDesc: Detach from {{serial}}. The equipment stays at {{location}}.
eq.detachInUseNote: The detached equipment (and the children that go with it) become Not in use.
eq.locationFromParent: Follows the parent — clear Parent equipment to set a location of its own.
eq.levelFromParent: Follows the parent — clear Parent equipment to set a level of its own.
eq.parentFixed: Adding a child of {{serial}} — fixed here. To use another parent, save first, then Move.
eq.swapNoChange: Both have the same parent and location, so swapping changes nothing.
eq.deleteDesc: Permanent — cannot be undone. History is kept.

imp.title: Import equipment from Excel
imp.step1Desc: The template has drop-down lists for Part number, Type, Level, Status and Location, taken from Configuration at download time; Tags takes tag names separated by ;. Download it again after Configuration changes.
imp.step2Desc: .xlsx only, up to {{max}} rows per import. The file is checked first — nothing is added until you press Import.
imp.allGood: All {{count}} rows are valid. Press Import to add them.
imp.hasErrors: {{count}} rows have errors. Fix them in the file and choose it again — nothing is added while any row has an error.
imp.duplicateExisting: Serial already exists — will still be added (warning only).
imp.duplicateFile: Same serial as row {{row}} in this file — will still be added (warning only).

issue.parent_not_found: {{column}}: "{{value}}" not found (in the system or in this file).
issue.parent_ambiguous: {{column}}: "{{value}}" matches {{count}} equipment — also fill in the part number, or leave blank and attach later with Move.
issue.parent_cycle: {{column}}: parent loop in this file (equipment cannot be its own ancestor).
issue.location_follows_parent: {{column}}: a child follows its parent's location ({{value}}) — leave this blank.
issue.level_follows_parent: {{column}}: a child follows its parent's level ({{value}}) — leave this blank.
issue.type_follows_part_number: {{column}}: follows the part number ({{value}}) — leave this blank.
issue.wrong_kind: {{column}}: "{{value}}" is not a Tester / Base / Fixture part number (sub-equipment go in the Sub-equipment import).
issue.parent_type_invalid: {{column}}: "{{value}}" cannot be the parent here (Tester ⊃ Base ⊃ Fixture; sub-equipment and golden boards go under a Tester / Fixture).
issue.usage_invalid: {{column}}: "{{value}}" is not a Status — use In use or Not in use.
issue.usage_follows_parent: {{column}}: a child follows its parent's status ({{value}}) — leave this blank.
issue.usage_needs_parent: {{column}}: only a Tester can be In use without a parent — attach it to a parent, or use Not in use.

file.not_xlsx: Only Excel .xlsx files are accepted — use the template.
file.unreadable: Cannot read the file. Open it in Excel, save as .xlsx and try again.
file.empty: The file has no data rows (start right below the header row).
file.too_many_rows: The file has {{count}} rows — at most {{max}} per import. Split the file.
file.missing_columns: Missing required columns: {{columns}}. Do not rename the header row — download the template again.
file.sendFailed: Could not send the file. If you edited it after choosing it, choose it again; otherwise check your network connection.

tpl.errorList: Pick a value from the list. If a value is missing, ask an admin to add it in Configuration, then download the template again.

cal.removeDesc: Delete the calibration of {{date}}? The Calibration Status is recomputed from the one before it. This cannot be undone.

gimp.title: Import golden boards from Excel
gimp.step1Desc: The template has drop-down lists for Location and Parent part number, taken from Configuration at download time. Download it again after Configuration changes.

cfg.optionsStale: The change was saved, but the dropdown lists could not be refreshed. Reload the page so forms use the new lists.
cfg.partNumberFixed: The part number cannot be changed — delete this setup and add a new one.
cfg.calibrationDeleteWarning: Delete the setup for {{name}}? Calibrations already recorded keep their due date; the next one needs a due date typed in.
cfg.systemTypeLocked: Tester, Base and Fixture are system Types — they cannot be hidden.
cfg.groupLocked: The Group of Tester, Base and Fixture is fixed.
cfg.systemGroupLocked: Tester, Base and Fixture are system Groups — they cannot be hidden.

usr.ownRoleLocked: You cannot change your own role.
usr.resetDesc: Create a new temporary password for {{name}}. The current password stops working, and they must choose their own at next sign-in.
usr.disableDesc: Lock {{name}}? They are signed out and cannot use the app until you unlock the account. Accounts are never deleted.
usr.usernameLocked: A username cannot be changed after the account is created.

temp.createdDesc: Account {{username}} ({{name}}) was created. Give this password to the user.
temp.resetDesc: The password of {{username}} ({{name}}) was reset. Give the new temporary password to the user.
temp.note: It is shown only once. The user must choose their own password at the first sign-in.
temp.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically — select the password above and copy it manually.
temp.closeBody: The password will not be shown again (you can reset it later).

dash.denied: You do not have permission to view that page.
dash.unavailable: Dashboard numbers can't be shown right now.
dash.welcomeText: Set up the Configuration lists first (locations, part numbers, tags), then add equipment or import an Excel file.
dash.welcomeReadonly: No equipment has been entered yet. Ask an Admin or a User to add some.

scope.status: Equipment, sub-equipment and golden boards. Calibration status counts sub-equipment only.
scope.overdue: All sub-equipment past due, any tester or location. "Failed" is counted separately.
scope.dueSoon: All sub-equipment inside their warning period, any tester or location.
scope.type: All {{total}} assets, each counted once. Golden boards have no type.
scope.tag: All {{total}} assets. Assets without a tag are listed as Untagged.
scope.recent: One line per user action, in the modules you can access.

adminUsers.errorPasswordTooShort: Password must be at least 10 characters.

errors.LOGIN_RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please try again shortly.
errors.USER_INACTIVE: This account is locked. Contact an admin.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED: You need to change your password before continuing.
errors.IN_USE: This record is still in use and cannot be deleted.
errors.USERNAME_ALREADY_EXISTS: This username is already in use.
errors.LAST_ADMIN: There must always be at least one active admin.
errors.LOCATION_INHERITED_READ_ONLY: This equipment has a parent, so its location follows the parent. Clear its parent (or Detach) to set its own location.
errors.CALIBRATION_INTERVAL_MISSING: The part number has no calibration interval.
errors.LOCK_TIMEOUT: Someone else is changing this right now. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.SERVER_ERROR: System error. Please try again, or contact an admin with the request ID.
errors.SWAP_NO_CHANGE: Both have the same parent and location, so the swap would change nothing.
errors.SWAP_TYPE_MISMATCH: Only assets of the same kind and Type can be swapped (Fixture with Fixture, Base with Base, DMM with DMM…).
errors.EQUIPMENT_IN_USE: This asset is In use. Check it in before deleting it or changing its location.
errors.USAGE_NO_CHANGE: Nothing to change — everything is already in this state.
errors.USAGE_NEEDS_PARENT: Only a Tester can be In use without a parent. Attach this asset to a parent first.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Cannot connect to the server. Check your network connection and try again.
errors.TIMEOUT: The server is taking too long to respond. Please try again.
errors.CONFLICT: This conflicts with the current data. Reload and try again.
errors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The data or file sent is too large.
errors.UNKNOWN_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.TAG_IN_USE: This tag is in use and cannot be deleted.
errors.ADMIN_SELF_CHANGE: You cannot lock, demote or reset your own account here.
errors.PARENT_TYPE_INVALID: This asset cannot be attached to that parent (see the asset tree rules).
errors.PARENT_NOT_IN_USE: The parent is not In use, so this child cannot be checked out on its own. Check out the parent first (or both together).
errors.TYPE_KIND_INVALID: This part number / Type is not valid here.
errors.TYPE_SYSTEM_LOCKED: Tester, Base and Fixture are system Types and cannot be changed.
errors.PART_NUMBER_IN_USE: Equipment already uses this part number, so its Type can no longer change.
errors.DATABASE_OUT_OF_DATE: The database is not up to date for this version of the app. An admin needs to run the latest SQL migration, then reload.
errors.HISTORY_IS_APPEND_ONLY: History rows cannot be edited or deleted.

simp.title: Import sub-equipment from Excel
simp.step1Desc: The template has drop-down lists for Part number, Type and Location, taken from Configuration at download time. Download it again after Configuration changes.

asset.changeLocationDesc: Move the device and everything under it to another location. Only possible while it has no parent and is not In use.
asset.childrenFollow: Its children go along: location, Level and Status of the whole branch change together.

moveDesc.equipment: The device takes the location, Level and Status of its new parent; its children go along. Allowed even while In use.
moveDesc.sub_equipment: The sub-equipment is placed in a tester and takes its location and Status. Allowed even while In use.
moveDesc.golden_board: The golden board is attached to a tester or fixture and takes its location and Status. Allowed even while In use.

asset.deleteCalibrationsWarn: Its calibration records are deleted with it.
asset.serialExistsHint: You can still save — press Save anyway.
asset.calibrationSummary: {{overdue}} overdue · {{dueSoon}} due soon · {{attention}} not calibrated / failed · {{valid}} valid
asset.locationFromTester: Follows the tester — detach from the tester to set its own location.
